thread:
matt: Heads-up: following up on the 'quota telemetry contract' RFC — we need a concrete minimal contract for Dedicated + Private so SRE can rely on it for soft-evictions.

sara: +1. Main ask: how do we report token-level consumption vs billing units? We can't double-count when batching.

linh: short answer: report both raw_tokens and billing_units with same request_id tag so we can join. Also include sampling flag for heavy clients.

anil: Danger: request_id cardinality will explode. Prefer hashed_request_bucket (e.g., 64) instead of raw ids.

matt: agreed — propose request_shard: sha1(req_id) % 64. Also add tenant_id, model, route_name, quantization_profile.

sara: What about privacy/compliance in Private deployments? tenant_id ok, but no global tenant map. Use local tenant_alias and allow opt-out.

linh: Implementation note: ingestion should accept protobuf v2 -> fields: tenant_alias, request_shard, raw_tokens, billed_units, abuse_signal_score, sample_rate

matt: example proto:
```proto
message QuotaEvent {
  string tenant_alias = 1;
  uint32 shard = 2;
  uint64 raw_tokens = 3;
  uint64 billed_units = 4;
  float abuse_score = 5;
  uint32 sample_rate = 6;
  string model = 7;
}
```

sara: nice. Telemetry pipeline: we need both a high-cardinality index for debug and an aggregated stream for SLO dashboards.

anil: for high-cardinality debug, keep a 24h raw log with TTL. For dashboards, aggregate per-minute per-shard.

kai: how do we surface 'soft-eviction' safety hooks? quota service should emit 'evict_recommendation' events with reason and trace_id.

matt: I'd rather emit decision_tombstone: {tenant_alias, decision, reason_code, trace_id} in same Kafka topic. Consumers can subscribe.

sara: consumer side: Console needs a samples API to pull recent decision_tombstones and link to requests (via shard). Add index on shard+minute.

linh: rollout plan: 1) schema in ingestion, 2) ship producer lib with sample_rate default 1/100, 3) enable on willowy workload for 1wk, 4) SRE validate.

anil: testing: synthetic replay with 10x traffic to ensure aggregation doesn't lag >60s. Also privacy review for Private.

matt: open question: should abuse_score be pre- or post-admission? Pre lets us correlate attempt patterns; post-admission shows actual cost.

sara: need both. include attempt_abuse_score and consumed_abuse_score fields.

matt: I'll update the proto and open a small RFC patch. tagging @eng-sre @eng-security for privacy + ops concerns. :eyes: 

ops-bot: deploy-checklist created: https://infra/checklists/QUOTA-TELEMETRY-ROLLOUT

kai: thanks — i'll take ops validation and schedule canary 2024-05-02.
